import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
inp,out=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
from collections import deque
seeds=[(i,j,v) for i,r in enumerate(inp) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v not in (0,1)]
print(seeds)
# flood fill: each seed color spreads through adjacent 1s
def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    owner=[[-1]*w for _ in range(h)]  # which seed owns
    q=deque()
    for i,r in enumerate(g):
        for j,v in enumerate(r):
            if v not in (0,1):
                owner[i][j]=v; q.append((i,j,v))
    # BFS; ties broken by first arrival
    while q:
        i,j,c=q.popleft()
        for di,dj in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            ni,nj=i+di,j+dj
            if 0<=ni<h and 0<=nj<w and g[ni][nj]==1 and owner[ni][nj]==-1:
                owner[ni][nj]=c; res[ni][nj]=c; q.append((ni,nj,c))
    return res
pred=f(inp)
print(pred==out)
diff=[(i,j,inp[i][j],out[i][j],pred[i][j]) for i in range(30) for j in range(30) if pred[i][j]!=out[i][j]]
print(len(diff), diff[:10])

import os,json
def transform(grid):
    g=grid; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    sd=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v not in (0,1)]
    if not sd: return [r[:] for r in g]
    ds=[geo(g,s) for s in sd]
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(1,h-1):
        for j in range(1,w-1):
            if g[i][j]==1 and all(g[i+a][j+b]!=0 for a in(-1,0,1) for b in(-1,0,1)):
                vals=[d.get((i,j)) for d in ds]
                m=min(v if v is not None else 10**9 for v in vals)
                cand=[k for k,v in enumerate(vals) if v is not None and v==m]
                # tie-break by manhattan
                best=min(cand or range(len(sd)), key=lambda k:(vals[k] if vals[k] is not None else 10**9, abs(sd[k][0]-i)+abs(sd[k][1]-j)))
                res[i][j]=g[sd[best][0]][sd[best][1]]
    return res
